meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后，用户给出一个目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或当前对话，Claude 会把它改写为可复用的技能文件（SKILL.md），存到 .claude/skills/<名称>/ 目录；若已有同主题技能，则读取原文件就地更新。
howto.when: 当用户说“/learn”“learn this”“turn this into a skill”等，或要求把目录、网址、粘贴的笔记等做成技能时触发。

say.text: /learn 把刚才的操作做成技能
say.note: Claude 会从对话中提炼流程并生成 SKILL.md。

say.text: 把这个网址的用法整理成技能
say.note: Claude 会抓取该网页并提炼步骤。

say.text: 改进一下现有的部署技能
say.note: Claude 会读取原技能并就地更新。

howto.what_en: Learns from a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation and writes a reusable SKILL.md into .claude/skills/<name>/, or refines an existing skill in place.
howto.when_en: Triggered by '/learn', 'learn this', etc., or when the user wants to distill a directory, URL, or pasted notes into a skill.

say_en.text: /learn turn what we just did into a skill
say_en.note: Claude distills the workflow from the conversation.

say_en.text: Turn the usage of this URL into a skill
say_en.note: Claude fetches the page and distills the steps.
Claude reads the current skill and updates it in place.
